title: BLIP
paper_title: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation
core_mech: 区别于纯双塔，BLIP 用共享 MED 同时承担对齐、跨注意力匹配和因果生成，并把 captioner-filter 作为数据循环的一部分。
core_mech_en: Unifies vision–language understanding and generation via a Multimodal Mixture of Encoder–Decoder (MED) coupled with a CapFilt data bootstrapping loop.
input_desc: 图像、原始网页描述及由 captioner 生成的合成描述
input_en: Image + noisy web caption + synthetically generated and filtered captions
output_desc: 图文检索/匹配表示和自回归图像描述
output_en: Unimodal embeddings (ITC), cross-modal matching scores (ITM), and autoregressive captions (LM)

source.title: BLIP
notes: The upstream repository is archived. Pin and isolate its legacy dependencies before attempting the original workflow.

gaps: BLIP requires the image–text contrastive/matching/language objectives and captioning/filtering workflow; the full original method is not implemented here.
